# OMP Strata

> Profile, lifecycle tool and acceptance evidence for running the stock Oh My Pi (OMP) coding agent against
> a stock, local Strata inference server on one Windows 11 + RTX host. It forks neither project and adds no
> proxy: every download is pinned by URL, size and SHA-256; stock `setup.py` runs unmodified from verified
> local inputs; Strata binds to loopback behind an API key; stock OMP runs in an isolated profile with every
> model role on the local server and no cloud fallback. Python standard library only. Qualified and current (2026-11-03):
> stock Strata v0.2.10 (engine 0.1.56) + stock OMP 18.16.0 across all three hosts and the Mac Studio route: on the
> RTX 4090 + RTX 3090 pair in `rtx3090-win-a` (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next IQ3_S at the trained 262,144-token context, stock
> roles `--gpu-roles 0=main,1=helper` putting the RTX 4090 as Main staged last, manual layer split 24 `--layer-split 24`,
> stage dense-weight trim `--trim-stage-weights` (`strata.trim_stage_weights: true`), stock DFlash2 drafting alone
> via `strata.drafting: "dflash2"` (`--draft dflash2 --draft-model <root>\data\dflash2\qwen3.8-flash-next-dflash2.q4_0-selq4.pack --draft-fallback none --draft-conf 0.35 --draft-vocab <root>\data\dflash2\draft_vocab.bin`,
> packed offline during `install` by stock `tools/dflash2_pack.py` from pinned `incoai/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-DFlash2` files
> with `STRATA_NO_ACQUIRE=1`), dropping `--pipeline-windows 2` and growing the expert caches to 19.41 GiB on the RTX 3090
> and 18.31 GiB on the RTX 4090, 19,894 resident experts = 81%, vs 19.14 and 17.75 GiB, 19,469 = 79%, on the v0.2.10
> `pw2` (`--pipeline-windows 2`) `env86g` multi-token prediction (MTP) rollback and keeping G17's near-limit task wall at
> 59.0 s vs 59.9 s on `pw2`, no batch slots, display on the RTX 4090, `strata.ple_io: "direct"` pinning stock
> `--ple-io direct` to keep the 26.8 GiB per-layer embedding (PLE) table on direct SSD reads, preserving the engine's
> 8,192 MiB automatic conversation cache and 27.51 GiB G10 Windows commit headroom of a 135.69 GiB limit with 65.65 GiB
> available RAM, and `strata.engine_env` pinning the engine's `sm_86` default table `sm86_table` and stock `gdn_stack`,
> which in three paired cold starts against its v0.2.10 `pw2` `env86g` MTP rollback (45.0-45.1 s to ready, 65.65-65.66 GiB
> available RAM at ready, 31.4 GiB startup commit headroom of 135.7 GiB) raised cold decode +8.2% at 8K (1.082), +9.3% at
> 100K (1.093), +10.1% at depth 0 (1.101), +13.6% at 32K (1.136) and +7.7% on warm 32K (1.077), kept TTFT at 8K-100K at
> 0.955-0.980 and `w1` / `w3` throughput at 1.001 / 1.033, and passed all 14 measured gates in the 2026-11-03
> requalification chain at `837bc89` (`1f2d483`) with 43.1-43.4 s restart readiness, G24 17/18, pilot 5/6 and batch wall
> 916 s after the owner overrode its 6-token-window inter-event gap (`w3` max gap 1.075-1.112, p95 inter-event gap
> 1.122-1.170), queued-prefill (0.802, prompt time 1.227) and empty-prompt TTFT (1.052) misses;
> `win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-262k-df2-disp4090-roles-split24-trimweights-pledirect-env86g-parking-strata0.2.10-omp18.16.0`;
> [ledger](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-262k-df2-disp4090-roles-split24-trimweights-pledirect-env86g-parking-strata0.2.10-omp18.16.0/qualification.json);
> rolling back to the v0.2.10 `pw2` `env86g` MTP profile
> `win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-262k-pw2-disp4090-roles-split24-trimweights-pledirect-env86g-parking-strata0.2.10-omp18.16.0`
> with G10 27.54 GiB commit headroom of 135.69 GiB and 65.37 GiB available RAM, G16/G20/G21 55.3 / 43.2 / 55.7 s, G17
> near-limit task 59.9 s, G24 16/18, pilot 5/6, batch wall 1,045 s; the v0.2.9 `env86g` profile
> `win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-262k-pw2-disp4090-roles-split24-trimweights-pledirect-env86g-parking-strata0.2.9-omp18.15.0`
> and v0.2.9 base profile

## Install

- From a checkout, with the current candidate profile: `validate` → `fetch` → `install` → `keygen` →
  `start` → `launch-omp` → `stop` (`py -3 scripts\omp_strata.py <command> --profile <profile> --root <root>`).
- One integration root per candidate; nothing is written to the user's normal OMP configuration or to
  `%APPDATA%\Strata`.

## Boundaries

- Supported: the qualified profiles under `profiles/` (Windows 11, a single NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000, RTX 5090, RTX 3090
  or RTX 4090, or the RTX 4090 + RTX 3090 layer-split pair; every other profile is a draft or a rollback installation),
  text only, single user, loopback only.
- Remote use: the Mac Studio's current qualified route,
  `client-rtxpro6000-262k-batchmtp-pledirect-kvvram-envpg-strata0.2.10-omp18.16.0`, runs stock OMP 18.16.0 through an
  SSH local forward to `win11-rtxpro6000-iq3s-262k-slots4-batchmtp-pledirect-kvvram-envpg-parking-strata0.2.10-omp18.16.0`,
  the PRO's current v0.2.10 262K `kvvram-envpg` profile. Its independent G23 passed on 2026-11-03 at `9a06ec1`: missing
  key refused before launch, wrong key 401, health RTT 21.9-24.4 ms and stream TTFT 0.219 s; tunnel drop failed the turn
  in flight with the prior transcript preserved, nonce recall passed after tunnel reopen (0.82 s), client restart
  (0.67 s) and verified server restart (1.41 s), and a one-turn `launch-omp` smoke answered `ROUTE OK` with owned stop.
  Its qualified rollback, `client-rtxpro6000-262k-batchmtp-pledirect-kvvram-envpg-strata0.2.9-omp18.15.0`, reaches the
  PRO's v0.2.9 262K `kvvram-envpg` rollback (G23 pass on 2026-11-02 at `acd7549`). The 0.2.9 batch-MTP base, 0.2.8
  batch-MTP, 0.2.8 `slots4-parking`, 0.2.7, 0.2.3, 0.2.1, 0.1.44.1, 0.1.43.1, 0.1.43 and 0.1.42 262K routes and
  `client-rtxpro6000-strata0.1.41-omp18.8.6` 131K route stay earlier history.
- Not supported: images, remote clients other than those qualified current and rollback Mac-to-RTX PRO 6000 routes, other
  operating systems, durable engine state across restarts, multiple tenants. Comparisons with other runtimes are
  separate, comparison-only tools.
- Security: loopback only, API key required on every model, control and metrics route, key in a user-only
  file, ambient provider credentials scrubbed from OMP's environment, no telemetry. Not a sandbox, a
  multi-tenant service or an egress firewall.

## Canonical documents

- [README](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata#readme): status, what the tool does, layout, host-free checks
- [Quickstart](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/QUICKSTART.md): the tested install, start, use and stop commands
- [Operations](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/OPERATIONS.md): lifecycle, recovery, logs, upgrades, requalifying a new tuple
- [Security](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/SECURITY.md): what is and is not isolated, observed egress, known defects
- [Measurements](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/MEASUREMENTS.md): resources, throughput, context, restart cost, evaluation results
- [Decision](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/DECISION.md): integration readiness, usefulness, further investment
- [Baseline](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/BASELINE.md): the frozen component tuple and why it was chosen
- [Upstream](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/UPSTREAM.md): findings reported to Strata and Oh My Pi
